false_findings_avoided: /env and /settings put <form> directly inside <tr>; querySelectorAll('form [name]') returned ZERO fields and read as 'Save posts nothing'. form.elements showed 3 each and clicking Save really stored the value. Not a defect.

A newline probe through <input type=password> returned 303 and read as 'newline guard missing'. The browser strips LF from input values, so the server received 'abcEVIL=1'. Re-run through a textarea: 400.

That stripped submit REPLACED the canary in .env, so the next 'paste the live credential into name' probe was accepted and read as a BR-6 leak. The value was no longer in .env. Re-run with a value really present: 400.
crawl approval with offset 5000 returned 303 and read as 'offset bound missing'. The page's submit handler overwrites the field with the browser's real offset. Injected after that handler: 400.
A 'no steps' case was accepted -- the first step row is prefilled with the base_url navigate by design; not a defect.
